title: Introduce Helm safety rails and tenant bootwave config schema
author: Priya Patel
description:
Background: private installs of Redwood need safer upgrade and init paths when tenants are numerous or networking is constrained. This PR adds a compact set of Helm safety rails: a validated values.schema.json for tenant bootwave and init sequencing, optional graceful-prelude init job, and templated annotations to guard rollback/upgrade windows. Motivation: previous incidents showed opaque failures during multi-tenant preflight and seeding; automation must make implicit assumptions explicit and fail fast with actionable errors.

What this PR does: Adds a consolidated values schema (charts/private/values.schema.json) that documents and validates the new 'bootwave' config object: concurrency profiles, jitter windows, API preflight probes and quota hints. Introduces a lightweight templated 'prelude' init job (templates/init-prelude-job.yaml) that can optionally run pre-seed connectivity checks and emit step-level events to the hook controller. Adds hook annotations and a new 'safeRollout' template helper to ensure rollbacks are gated on a quorum of tenant seeds completing successfully. Also updates NOTES.txt and README with migration guidance and a short troubleshooting list.

Compatibility and migration: The schema is additive and defaulted to the current behavior. Clusters using stricter policy will get validation failures on helm install/upgrade unless they opt into the new values object or set 'bootwave.enabled=false'. Documented migration steps included. For on-prem customers using the Private installer, the PR also includes a small change to the installer overlay to map terraform-provided 'seed_concurrency' into the chart values.

Testing and rollout: unit tests for schema validation and helm template rendering were added (tests/helm-schema-test.sh). End-to-end canary performed in our staging tenant-slice with 120 tenants and a seeded jitter profile; the bootwave prelude prevented a mass seeding retry storm observed in previous runs. CI: lint -> template -> unit tests passed; e2e run was performed manually in staging.

Risks and mitigations: introducing user-visible validation can block installs; mitigated by conservative defaults, clear error messages and a single-step escape hatch 'bootwave.enabled=false'. Operational docs include sample values for common environments.

Related: ENG-4271 (tenant bootwave design), PRs that touched hooks and init sequencing.

release_notes:
- Add bootwave values schema and tenant concurrency profiles
- Optional prelude init job for safe seeding and connectivity preflight
- Hook annotations and helper templates to gate rollbacks
- Installer overlay mapping for terraform seed concurrency
notes_for_ops: When upgrading clusters with many tenants, consider increasing the default 'bootwave.jitterWindow' to spread seed traffic; to bypass validation temporarily set 'bootwave.enabled=false' in values. For Private installer customers using Terraform, ensure the 'seed_concurrency' output is present in the overlay mapping.
